name: Judson Sapp
subject: National, State, and Local Leaders Endorse Judson Sapp
body:
Husband. Father. Businessman. Proven Conservative. | | | [ ](https://judsonsapp.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=786f9905f43902655e694a1cd&id=4970bda2c7&e=dc147d445f)
---
|
---
| _**Husband. Father. Businessman.
Proven Conservative.**_
---
|
---
|
---
“**Judson Sapp is the leader Putnam County needs to continue the progress we have made.** He’s a respected businessman, a dedicated father, and a solid conservative we can count on to fight for us. As a Putnam County Commissioner, I look forward to working with Judson as our next State Representative.”
**-Putnam County Commissioner Larry Harvey**
|
---
|
---
“I am proud to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative. Judson is a native of Northeast Florida, he runs a successful business, helps local charities, and is raising a family here. **Judson Sapp is a staunch supporter of law enforcement and understand the needs of our community.** I look forward to working with Judson as our next State Representative to preserve the Florida we all know and love.”
**-Putnam County Sheriff Gator DeLoach**
|
---
|
---
“**Judson Sapp is a leader North Florida can trust to work hard, get results, and stand firm for our conservative values.** I’m proud to endorse Judson for State Representative and look forward to working with him to keep Florida free.”
**-Florida CFO Jimmy Patronis**
|
---
|
---
“We need more genuine conservatives like Judson Sapp who know how to create prosperity for Florida families. **With his deep authentic North Florida roots, traditional values, and job creating business experience, Judson Sapp is the conservative we need.** I am proud to endorse him for the Florida House of Representatives.”
_**-State Representative Dean Black**_
|
---
|
---
“Judson Sapp is a leader who understands the unique needs of our community. **He is an unwavering conservative and a steadfast supporter of law enforcement.** I am proud to endorse Judson Sapp to be our next State Representative.”
**-Clay County Sheriff Michelle Cook**
|
---
|
---
“**I’ve known Judson Sapp all his life. Judson is a devoted husband and father, an astute businessman, a true conservative, and he will make a fine public servant.** I am honored to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative.”
**-Congressman John Rutherford**
|
---
|
---
“The Florida House has advanced a conservative agenda of lower taxes, less regulations, empowering parents, supporting our law enforcement, and protecting our freedoms. **I know Judson Sapp will make an excellent Representative, joining me and our Republican team, to keep Florida free, safe, and even more prosperous.** ”
_**-State Representative Chuck Brannan**_
|
---
|
---
“**Judson Sapp is a man of character who has dedicated himself to making our community a better place.** He will be a consistent conservative voice in the legislature and one who will fight for us. I’m proud to endorse Judson Sapp to be our next State Representative.”
**-Clay County Superintendent David Broskie**
|
---
|
---
“As a former State Representative and State Senator, I know what it takes to lead in Tallahassee. **Judson Sapp is the very type of leader we need in the legislature to fight for lower taxes, support our law enforcement, expand school choice, and keep Florida free.** I’m proud to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative and I look forward to working with Judson to keep North Florida the best place in America to start a business and raise a family.”
**-Congressman Aaron Bean**
| |
---
|
---
“Judson Sapp has been a leader in business and in charitable efforts throughout Northeast Florida. **He’s proven to be a tireless fighter for our first responders and our conservative values.** There is no better candidate to take the lead for us in Tallahassee than Judson Sapp and I’m proud to support him to be our next State Representative!”
**-Clay County Clerk of Court Tara Green**
|
---
|
---
“As Sheriff it’s my duty to protect the citizens of Marion County. To keep Florida safe we need strong law and order legislators who will stand up for our law enforcement officers. **Judson Sapp is a friend of law enforcement and I am proud to endorse him to be our next State Representative.** ”
**-Marion County Sheriff Billy Woods**
|
---
|
---
“To ensure Florida remains the most law enforcement friendly state in the nation, we need legislators in Tallahassee who strongly support our men and women in law enforcement. **Judson Sapp is a solid leader we can count on to fight for our values, stand up for law and order, and represent Northeast Florida.** I am proud to support Judson Sapp to be the next State Representative from District 20.” **-St. Johns County Sheriff Rob Hardwick**
|
---
|
---
“I’m proud to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative. **He understands the needs of our community and will work for the people, not the special interests.** There is no one better to represent us in Tallahassee than Judson Sapp.”
**-Clay County School Board Member Beth Clark**
|
---
|
---
“**Judson Sapp is the leader we need in Tallahassee to stand up for parents and taxpayers.** He’ll put Florida first and never back down to special interests. We can count on Judson to fight for what’s right.”
**-Clay County School Board Member Erin Skipper**
|

## We've Been Lied To...
---
When it comes to the history of the United States of America, we have been _intentionally_ not told the entire story. Our **Founding Father's** are _demonized_ in public school history classes and we are told by "_leaders_ " like **Barak Obama** that America was not founded as a Christian Nation. This last Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12581536.6504.1.7ff9656da2ba4a5b08daf3db522e8423) in OKC & Tulsa, I spoke on a subject matter that I am passionate about. I received a B.A. & M.A. from Oral Roberts University in Theological & Historical Studies (much of which covered the history of America). In this message, you will hear the [TRUE story of America](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12581536.6505.1.634aeb5e01965331e2c5615c560a2b8e). It will bless and encourage you. Last Monday, June 24, marked two years since the U.S. Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , ending Americans' constitutional right to abortion. Since that disastrous ruling, the cases reaching the Court continue to jeopardize the reproductive freedom and civil rights of _millions_ of Americans.

Friend --
As you know, Michigan's Republican Senate primary is coming up soon. And in the weeks before the race, GOP candidates in our race and others are talking to people trying to capture something called "voter IDs."
A "voter ID" is just a simple declaration of support from potential voters.
It is a campaign contacting a voter, and a voter saying "Yes, I support you," or "no, I am supporting someone else."
These replies are the foundation of any campaign, because it’s how we know where our supporter base exists and who we need to turn out in November.
Before the election, campaigns try to make sure their stated supporters vote. And at other times -- especially when a candidate needs it most -- they will turn to those supporters for help.
So today, we are doing the same. We are asking you to add your name as a "Personal Endorser" of Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate. It's a small and simple act, but it will speak volumes about the grassroots support for our campaign:

# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1218%2E791427%2EPHhTAN)

Friends -
I intend to support articles of impeachment for the corrupt right-wing politicians masquerading as justices on the United States Supreme Court.
**[If you agree we must restore trust and justice to our nation’s highest court, add your name to mine today to demand Congress impeach every authoritarian on the Supreme Court.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-scotus-impeach/?source=em240702-1&refcode2=1218.791427.PHhTAN&akid=1218%2E791427%2EPHhTAN)**

If Donald Trump is reelected, this convicted felon, rapist, and twice-impeached former President will be able to do whatever the hell he wants.

subject: Why is Kucinich running?
body:
| |
---
Peter, Dennis Kucinich has entered our race against Max Miller as a “spoiler” candidate. I never agreed with everything Dennis said, but I used to feel he had strong principles. He was a stalwart anti-war figure who stood for peace. But now, he’s thrown those principles out the window and embraced the far-right. Dennis went to CPAC and appeared on Steve Bannon’s show. And he’s adopted the language and stances of the far-right, railing against Ukraine, vaccines, and the “deep state.” We've seen third party candidates help Donald Trump and the MAGA right by entering the race as "spoilers" and then only attacking the Democrat. That's likely happening in our race. The difficulty in this race just got turned up a notch. We're up against Max Miller and Dennis Kucinich in this race, and it looks like they're on the same team. Folks, _over 1.5 million donors_ contributed more than _$264 million_ to help fund this campaign last quarter alone. **That’s incredible,****Peter.** I’m told that $38 million of that fundraising came in the four days directly following my debate against Donald Trump -- and a whopping $30 million of that came in the form of grassroots donations from those pitching in under $200 a piece. Look, big change starts small.
That's a lesson that my grandmother, Polly Noonan, first taught me decades ago. Well before most women had any political power, my grandmother organized women into a political force in Albany.
By the time I was in elementary school, I was tagging along with her to all kinds of Democratic campaign headquarters, rallies and events. She remains one of my biggest role models — and I carry her wisdom with me to this day. **She taught me that my voice matters, that women’s voices matter and that grassroots activism matters. And she showed me how campaigns are won by the people who put in the work like the volunteers knocking doors, stuffing envelopes, turning out the vote and donating what they can, when they can.**
For decades, first by my grandmother's side and then as a public servant myself, I've seen how those small grassroots actions all add up to victory on Election Day. That's how Democrats defeated the odds in 2022 to defend and even expand our Senate majority. And that's why I know that we can win again in 2024.
With Democrats defending 23 seats, the odds are certainly stacked against us. And after the 2022 red wave in New York, Republicans here are already targeting my seat for defeat. **But when people like you get off the sidelines and chip in even just $3, eventually we'll build a grassroots movement capable of defeating even the GOP's wealthiest megadonors.**

Well before most women had any political power, my grandmother organized women into a political force in Albany. By the time I was in elementary school, I was tagging along with her to all kinds of Democratic campaign headquarters, rallies and events. She remains one of my biggest role models — and I carry her wisdom with me to this day. She taught me that my voice matters, that women’s voices matter and that grassroots activism matters. And she showed me how campaigns are won by the people who put in the work like the volunteers knocking doors, stuffing envelopes, turning out the vote and donating what they can, when they can. For decades, first by my grandmother's side and then as a public servant myself, I've seen how those small grassroots actions all add up to victory on Election Day. | Dear Friend,

What happens when you campaign as a conservative, but govern as a social democrat?

**Ben Shapiro and I discussed how conservatives that failed to act conservative are about to be electorally annihilated across the Atlantic. **
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=7f44435e87&e=5703353baa)
---
| **If Mississippi conservatives want to keep winning, they need to deliver. **

That means:
* Giving parents the freedom to send their child to a school of their choice.
* Action to combat the Diversity, Equity and Inclusion agenda that is taking over our public institutions.
* Cutting taxes, not inventing new ways to squander Mississippi’s budget surplus.

**Just because someone happens to hunt, or have the right bumper sticker on their truck, does not make them conservative if they don’t deliver on the any of the above.**

Conservatives in Louisiana, Alabama and Arkansas have achieved more on school choice in 12 months than Mississippi has managed in 12 years.

I gave the speech last week and this is an excerpt about our urban and inner cities. It is also about our general school system here in Connecticut.
The issues facing Connecticut parents are no different than a lot of other places. I keep hearing that the Republican party is the party of racists. The Republican party and all Republicans have been unjustly accused of being a group of racists that is amplified by a media bias.
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=146207122&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2MjA3MTIyLCJpYXQiOjE3MTk5MzI2ODAsImV4cCI6MTcyMjUyNDY4MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.-ofdz2-0QZaz92oqJUtqTFDnn35VsSQ4hWyVjb0KhY4&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments)
**Nutmeggers of this Constitution State - It is time to flip the script.**
The real racists are the Democrats who have been able to achieve unbelievable amounts of grants and program funding, especially in inner cities, Yet, the return on these "investments" is not better education, but losses of future earning income and generations of poverty.
_**Our children in inner cities are especially at risk**_. It is a result of the Democrats that are perpetuating a lack of upward social mobility due to failing schools. I am a fighter and I am not afraid to call them out throughout the State. In my district, Mr. Himes is the real racist because he has done nothing to fight for school choice in cities like Bridgeport, Norwalk and Stamford. **I believe there are parents who may be registered Democrats that believe the same thing and will support candidates like me.**
As a physician that treats patients from all walks of life, I have a lot of first-hand experience treating children that attend public, private, charter and parochial schools. **There is a noticeable difference among the children enrolled in charter schools.** Those parents are happy their child made it to a charter school because they know their child has a path to success. For other parents that can afford it, they send their children to Catholic and other religious schools and also have that same level of hope.
The way we end racism in our inner cities is to improve education through competition and choice. This concept is hard to get past Democrat controlled cities. Competition can be viewed as threat to these failing education programs that receive funds but are not making an impact. This is in contrast to private after-school and other supplementary programs that rely on private donations. These are the programs that provide much needed services on a shoestring budget.
Just like students get graded, it is time for our schools to be held accountable for their failures to properly educate our children. It is critical that there is a meaningful return on the investment that taxpayers fund through federal government grants, real estate taxes and other sources of funding.
**In Bridgeport, 70.9 percent of school funding comes from the State, 19.2% is local (real-estate taxes) and 9.9 percent comes from the federal government. Bridgeport is ranked 161 out of 165 Connecticut School Districts.**
**It is our moral obligation to leave no child behind and the only way to do so is through a competitive and more robust education system.** Public school education is not competitive. While education is not considered a business in the traditional sense, it is really the business of creating economic opportunity to train our future leaders.
_**Our children deserve to thrive. When our youth, especially urban youth, start off at a scholastic disadvantage due to failed schools with no other options, this is a form of racism that must be exposed and solved.**_
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=146207122&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2MjA3MTIyLCJpYXQiOjE3MTk5MzI2ODAsImV4cCI6MTcyMjUyNDY4MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.-ofdz2-0QZaz92oqJUtqTFDnn35VsSQ4hWyVjb0KhY4)
_**For Parents, I say to you**_ - **Your Child, Your Choice**. If elected as your next Congressman, I will fight for a federal solution that will make education competitive through a meaningful access to school choice. School Choice can be achieved through investment in charter schools, school vouchers and working with the state to have school dollars follow the child to reduce the economic burdens associated with paying for religious and private schools. These home-schooling collectives that have sprouted up in the wake of Covid are not a sufficient alternative to this perpetual public school crisis that continues to leave our children behind while perpetuating this form of racism.
**MAKE YOUR VOICES HEARD ON AUGUST 13th BY GOING TO THE POLLS.**
Thank you for your continued support.
Dr. Michael Goldstein

(https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)

Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. 1 year after my thirst strike, we just got a new heat safety rule
I've got some BIG news I wanted to share with you first, Peter,
**Today the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) announced the first-ever federal heat rule to protect workers from extreme heat— _just one year after I held a thirst strike to highlight the need for federal protections._**
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88109454/483147737/-1363031704?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWE2MDczOS04YTM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TQnWrYg7wDUc3WfThu9H_SANZH57v41OwKE-KKE-5wQ=)**
Workers across the country have organized for decades to secure federal heat safety protections. And today, they’ve secured a major victory in that fight. This rule will help protect millions of workers from dangerous conditions, giving them a right to rest, shade, and water.
For too long, politicians like Greg Abbott have unfortunately sided with their corporate donors to reject these protections. Last year, Abbott even signed legislation that eliminated the right to basic things like water breaks for workers—despite triple-digit temperatures in Texas.
**That’s why I held an all-day thirst strike on the sunny steps of the U.S. Capitol to call for a federal heat safety standard—so that all workers are entitled to basic protections from extreme heat. Now, just one year after our strike, the Biden Administration is taking action. **
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88109455/483147738/1386970984?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWE2MDczOS04YTM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TQnWrYg7wDUc3WfThu9H_SANZH57v41OwKE-KKE-5wQ=)**

name: United College Park
subject: Welcome to United College Park! Here’s How You Can Get Involved
body:
Thank you for signing up to learn more about United College Park. We
are excited to have you join us in understanding and addressing some
of the current issues facing our community.

[image]

Dear Peter,

Thank you for signing up to learn more about United College Park. We
are excited to have you join us in understanding and addressing some
of the current issues facing our community. Together, we can work
towards being the change we want to see.

We believe in the power of community connection and look forward to
getting to know you better. Keep an eye out for opportunities to
connect with your neighbors and learn more about our initiatives.

WAYS TO CONTRIBUTE

We encourage you to explore the ways you can contribute listed below.
Your talents and interests can make a significant impact on our
community. United, let’s work together to create the community we
deserve.

* YARD SIGNS: Help spread the word about our initiatives by placing
yard signs in strategic locations.
* RECALL EFFORT: Join us in our efforts to recall and replace
ineffective representatives.
* SAVE BILL EVANS BASEBALL FIELD: Participate in the campaign to
preserve our beloved baseball field.
* STOP THE BATTERY STORAGE FACILITY: Assist in our mission to halt
the construction of a potentially harmful battery storage facility.

CELEBRATING INDEPENDENCE DAY

As we approach the 4th of July, we want to take a moment to celebrate
the spirit of independence and unity that defines our great nation.
It’s a time to reflect on the freedoms we cherish and the community
bonds that make College Park a special place to live. We wish you a
joyful and safe Independence Day filled with pride and celebration!

STAY CONNECTED

Be sure to stay connected with us for updates, events, and more ways
to get involved. Follow us on social media and join our discussions to
stay informed and engaged.

We look forward to working with you to build a better, more united
College Park!

Sincerely,

Your Neighbors at United College Park

United College Park 3667 Main St College Park, GA 30337 United
States

Hi Peter, Today, I’m emailing to extend my deepest gratitude to you. Sunday at midnight was our end-of-quarter deadline, and I’ll just say this, Peter: **I am blown away by your support.** I’m known for never slowing down in my efforts to uplift my community, but the only reason this is possible is because of the mountain of support I have behind me. For that, I cannot thank you enough. I’m truly humbled by your willingness to donate and share my vision for North Carolina. There will _always_ be work to be done, but thanks to the generosity of supporters like you, Peter, the foundation of this campaign is strong. I’m not exaggerating when I say every donation makes a difference. Every single cent raised allows us to ramp up our voter outreach initiatives, and continue making critical differences across our communities. With you by my side, Peter, I know our team has what it takes to keep pushing. I’m so grateful to have you on this journey. As we enter this next phase of the campaign to defend my seat, I want to reiterate that what keeps me going in this work, is a commitment to building a better future for our children, and a better life for our communities — and I’m not backing down now. Together, I know we can bring even more progress to North Carolina and our nation as a whole. Let’s keep pushing! With gratitude, Valerie

body:
| | Hi Peter, I want to make sure you don't miss this fun summer opportunity! I hope you'll join us for OLCV's Book Club. Together we'll be reading one of these great books of your choice and discussing it during our meeting at the end of August. [**Sign-ups close on Friday, July 5th, so don't miss your chance to explore an environmentally themed book with some friends.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88114496/483162727/-1529894987?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NDdlZTUzLTkwMzgtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=e_cOktt4y-aytJEY2XP3Wo4UeTk53nechtCJO-HAjKM=&emci=8ff705dd-f937-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0947ee53-9038-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) Sincerely,
Sarah Kline
OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88114504/483162749/-1989249276?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NDdlZTUzLTkwMzgtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=e_cOktt4y-aytJEY2XP3Wo4UeTk53nechtCJO-HAjKM=&emci=8ff705dd-f937-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0947ee53-9038-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)Hi Peter, I don’t know about you, but summer is the perfect time to read! One of my favorite parts about summer is reading on the beach or in the afternoons near the river when I’m out camping. That’s why I’m excited to announce that OLCV will be hosting a summer book club. Together we’ll be reading an environmental themed book that was voted on, share ideas, and make friends! [**In order to join, you must fill out this sign-up form here, where you’ll be asked to vote on the book we read and our meeting date. **](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88114505/483162765/-1529894987?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NDdlZTUzLTkwMzgtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=e_cOktt4y-aytJEY2XP3Wo4UeTk53nechtCJO-HAjKM=&emci=8ff705dd-f937-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0947ee53-9038-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) Our book club meeting will take place during the last week of August, between Monday August 26th to Thursday August 29th. The book will be announced after sign-ups close, but here’s the three nonfiction books we are choosing between:
1. **_The Intersectional Environmentalist_ by Leah Thomas:** envisions a world where the communities and voices most impacted by environmental injustice have the power, resources, and platforms to lead their communities into full liberation. (208 pages)

1. **_Emergent Strategy_ by adrienne maree brown:** explores radical self-help, society-help, and planet-help to shape the futures we want. (280 pages)

1. **_Becoming Kin: An Indigenous Call to Unforgetting the Past and Reimagining our Future_ by Patty Krawec:** visits Native and settler history, myth, identity, and spirituality helps us retrace our steps and pick up what was lost along the way: chances to honor rather than violate treaties, to see the land as a relative rather than a resource, and to unravel the history we have been taught. (240 pages)

**The deadline for sign-ups is on Friday, July 5th.[If you’re interested, please submit the sign-up form now!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88114509/483162768/-1529894987?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NDdlZTUzLTkwMzgtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=e_cOktt4y-aytJEY2XP3Wo4UeTk53nechtCJO-HAjKM=&emci=8ff705dd-f937-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0947ee53-9038-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) **[For those joining our book club, please join our Facebook group here if you’d like to connect before our meeting in August.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88114511/483162775/-619261988?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NDdlZTUzLTkwMzgtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=e_cOktt4y-aytJEY2XP3Wo4UeTk53nechtCJO-HAjKM=&emci=8ff705dd-f937-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0947ee53-9038-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) I’m looking forward to meeting some fellow readers and OLCV supporters this summer, and learn something together. See you in August! Sincerely,
Sarah Kline
OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator |

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Intel
subject: Educating our children honestly
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWngZSmWNa

American civics education, and specifically the teaching of
American history, is at a crisis point.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWngZSmWNa

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

American
civics education, and specifically the teaching of American
history, is at a crisis point.

In K-12
schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and
content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly
anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in
your local schools.

As a
result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to
be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American
ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats?

Or will
we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a
curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view
of our nation's history?

We must
insist on the latter, both for the sake of truth and for the sake
of our children and America's future.

For this
reason, we have produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum-and I'm
writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to
educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens
nationwide.

What is
the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum?

The
Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum is a K-12 history and civics curriculum
that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly
and comprehensively.

This
curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but
by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College-and we are making
it available free of charge.

To be
clear, the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum is not a slap-dash response
to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our
children.

It is a
2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying
American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused
effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of
Hillsdale College in 1844.

And we
need your help to make the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum available to
educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens
nationwide...and to make it available free of charge so that it
will have the greatest impact.

We have
set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the Hillsdale 1776
Curriculum and our other outreach efforts-including Imprimis,
free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school
initiative.

That's an
ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible.

One
reason why your support really matters: Hillsdale College refuses
to accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in
the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This makes
our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like
you-citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of
liberty.

We remind
ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission-to provide
"sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable
blessings of civil and religious liberty."

With that
mission in mind, we produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum-and
now we need your help to promote it nationwide.

Will you
take this opportunity to support the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum
and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty?

Understanding that a proper education is vital to the
preservation of liberty-and that the anti-American indoctrination
now being forced on too many American children poses an
existential threat to liberty-I hope you will make your most
generous tax-deductible gift today.

I've
included a secure link for your convenience here:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63352079:WngZSmWNa:m:3:2532013465:8D71F4613D90ED165361FA32279A6E98:r

Thank you
for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | |

Friends, I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift.
And I know we send a lot of emails already, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.
The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point.
But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump.

And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really.
**She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip.**
If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you.

The Jane Fonda Climate PAC raised a staggering $86,000 from emails alone last quarter! That's right, thousands of dedicated grassroots supporters like you — brimming with hope for real change — came together to fuel our mission. And oh, what a mission it is! If you ever wonder whether your support makes a difference, let me assure you — it absolutely does. Here’s a glimpse of what we've accomplished together this year:
* I’ve emailed you a few times about the dangerous referendum Big Oil was trying to put on the ballot in California to overturn an existing 2022 law that banned new oil drilling within 3,200 feet of schools, homes, and other sensitive areas. **Well, on the eve of the June 27th deadline to remove measures from the CA ballot, Big Oil buckled under the enormous weight of our collective pressure and dropped the referendum voluntarily.** But not before wasting $61 million on their efforts. Thank you for all you did to make this win possible.

* Across states like Arizona, Oregon, Texas, and Colorado, **we've endorsed more than a dozen candidates** who are fighting to transition to clean energy, hold the fossil fuel giants accountable, and say a big, fat NO to Big Oil money.

* Our endorsed candidate **Molly Cook won the special election in Texas, making her the first openly LGBTQ+ member to serve in the Texas State Senate.** Additionally, **Elliott Hood advanced in the Democratic primary race last week for CU Regent at Large in Colorado.**

* Remember the primary in California earlier this year? **Several of our endorsed climate champions came out on top, including Laura Friedman,** who triumphed in a 15-way primary to replace Adam Schiff in Congress!

* And let's not forget Arizona. While national headlines might miss these stories, we’re laser-focused on critical down-ballot races. **Take the Salt River Project, for instance, where we helped elect three climate champions to the SRP Board.** These leaders are now in prime positions to push for sustainable energy practices. Plus, **we’ve endorsed 11 bold candidates who have a historic opportunity** to create a pro-climate majority in the Arizona state legislature.

This, my friend, is what the power of your support looks like. This is the tangible impact of collective action. Don’t get me wrong — there’s still a lot of work ahead, and the road won't be easy but I’ve never been more hopeful. With you by my side, I believe we can break free from the greedy clutches of the fossil fuel industry and create a sustainable future for our children and grandchildren. Thank you for reading this. Now, let's keep fighting the good fight. _xx Jane Fonda_

Peter, we've seen A LOT happen to our abortion rights these last few weeks.
Last week, the Supreme Court ruled that pregnant people are allowed to continue receiving emergency abortion care if their life is at risk, under the Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act (EMTALA).

Just before that, the court ruled in favor of keeping mifepristone – a safe and crucial abortion pill – on the market.
But last week was also a stark reminder of how we got here, and that our reproductive rights are far from fully protected under the law. Last Monday marked the two year anniversary of the Dobbs decision – the ruling that overturned Roe v. Wade __ and ultimately put millions of Americans' abortion rights in jeopardy.
**The reality is that we shouldn't even be here. **

Because while our ultra-conservative Supreme Court may have fallen on the right side of history this time, the reason so many of these cases are making their way to the highest court is because SCOTUS has enabled far-right extremists to put any and every decision that has to do with our reproductive rights on the chopping block.

**GOP extremists are doing everything in their power to strip these critical and lifesaving treatments away from people seeking reproductive care, and ****they won't stop until they achieve their ultimate goal – a nationwide ban on abortion.**
As Attorney General, I have always fought tirelessly against anti-abortion extremists who seek to rob us of our reproductive freedoms – both in New York and across the country. With so much hanging in the balance, I refuse to stop that fight for even one second.
**We can't lose hope in our fight to protect our reproductive rights. It's more important than ever that we stand together and fight back against these attacks on our freedoms.**

I’m mad as hell.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88121156/483186182/-849459103?refcode=ea.e0f75ebe-9c38-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.e0f75ebe-9c38-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMGY3NWViZS05YzM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3KsbQpsxQLojgSF8n3qphIkuYy9sFgRixV9A1cnTLNM=&emci=aa291fb8-9c38-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=e0f75ebe-9c38-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=46764483)
---
Just when you think Tennessee Republicans couldn’t sink any lower, they stoop to new depths: **_Election officials sent letters to over 14,000 people last month asking for proof of U.S. citizenship to vote._** One of my own constituents, a proud new American citizen, received one of these intimidating letters despite becoming a citizen in 2022. This is happening all across our state, and it’s infuriating! Let’s be clear: This isn’t about protecting the integrity of our elections. It’s about silencing us. It’s about making it harder for everyday Tennesseans, especially those from marginalized communities, to exercise their fundamental right to vote. Our state is already ranked dead last in the nation for voter turnout, thanks to restrictive voting laws and practices. Tennesseans are tired of the GOP’s scare tactics. They’re tired of being bullied and intimidated by people like Marsha Blackburn and her radical allies. As your future Senator, I promise you this: I will fight tooth and nail to protect your right to vote. clean_body: I’m mad as hell. | Just when you think Tennessee Republicans couldn’t sink any lower, they stoop to new depths: Election officials sent letters to over 14,000 people last month asking for proof of U.S. citizenship to vote. One of my own constituents, a proud new American citizen, received one of these intimidating letters despite becoming a citizen in 2022. This is happening all across our state, and it’s infuriating! Let’s be clear: This isn’t about protecting the integrity of our elections. It’s about silencing us. It’s about making it harder for everyday Tennesseans, especially those from marginalized communities, to exercise their fundamental right to vote. Our state is already ranked dead last in the nation for voter turnout, thanks to restrictive voting laws and practices. Tennesseans are tired of the GOP’s scare tactics. They’re tired of being bullied and intimidated by people like Marsha Blackburn and her radical allies. I am writing to you today with a heavy heart as I condemn the recent 6-3 Supreme Court ruling in favor of granting "total immunity" to President Donald Trump for any criminal behavior regarding his official actions.
This decision is not just a blow to justice, but a sign of the increased partisanship in our highest court.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/scotusdb/ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/scotusdb/]
Per the US Hatch Act, this graphic does not imply an endorsement from Supreme Court Justice Sonia Sotomayor, or the the US Supreme Court.
JOIN OUR FIGHT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/scotusdb/]
Friends,
I dissent, too.
This level of partisanship is deeply troubling and goes against the principles of impartiality and fairness that the Supreme Court is supposed to uphold.
Our founding fathers crafted the Constitution to ensure that no individual, including the President, would have absolute power. Granting total immunity to anyone, especially the President, goes against that fundamental principle. No one should be above the law, especially the President.
As a candidate for Congress, I am committed to upholding the values enshrined in our Constitution. When the highest court in our land strays from these principles, I refuse to stay silent.
That's why I am reaching out to you today. I need your support to ensure that our voices are heard in Washington. Your contributions will help me stand up for justice and fight for accountability in our government.
I humbly ask for your support in this critical time. Let's show that we are a nation of laws.
Thank you for standing with me in this crucial fight.
-Bob

subject: A pretty wild story, if you have a minute
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota
body:
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never could’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never could’ve guessed that I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home. |
#
_Team, my friend Ruben Gallego asked if his team could reach out with an important message for you. Thanks!
– Tina_ Hola, my friend. It’s Ruben Gallego. You might be wondering how this kid... [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88121690/483187789/-907057436?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240702_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOGQ5OTZlNS05YzM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kHy5lN6Ymyth9Szv2OHWQt_PglCzV7fag6r0vT6F6MA=) ...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88121691/483187790/-907057436?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240702_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOGQ5OTZlNS05YzM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kHy5lN6Ymyth9Szv2OHWQt_PglCzV7fag6r0vT6F6MA=) Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88121694/483187791/-907057436?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240702_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOGQ5OTZlNS05YzM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kHy5lN6Ymyth9Szv2OHWQt_PglCzV7fag6r0vT6F6MA=) I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88121695/483187792/-907057436?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240702_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOGQ5OTZlNS05YzM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kHy5lN6Ymyth9Szv2OHWQt_PglCzV7fag6r0vT6F6MA=) Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88121696/483187793/-907057436?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240702_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOGQ5OTZlNS05YzM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kHy5lN6Ymyth9Szv2OHWQt_PglCzV7fag6r0vT6F6MA=) I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88121698/483187794/-907057436?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240702_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOGQ5OTZlNS05YzM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kHy5lN6Ymyth9Szv2OHWQt_PglCzV7fag6r0vT6F6MA=) You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88121699/483187797/-907057436?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240702_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOGQ5OTZlNS05YzM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kHy5lN6Ymyth9Szv2OHWQt_PglCzV7fag6r0vT6F6MA=) Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too. name: Candace Owens, BLEXIT
subject: BLEXIT backs the blue
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Fellow American,

I am so grateful for our police officers.

As an American who believes in law and order,
truth, and justice, I have always stood with the public servants
who protect our communities.

Please join me in thanking uniformed men and women
by signing our 'Back the Blue Petition' and letting brave
officers know that we are grateful for their service and
sacrifice.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began
propelling criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to
"defund the police."

I refuse to accept that we must cater to the bottom
denominator of our society and that the black community must
fight and scream and demand support for the people in our
community who are up to no good.

That's one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT - an
organization focused on shifting the culture in Black America as
well as educating and uplifting minorities through educational
programs and acts of community service.

Around the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have
supported local officers, while so many others have turned their
backs on those who serve our communities.

To join these chapters and stand with police
officers, please sign the national petition today.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

This summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving
back to the Baltimore Police Department and learned some history
about the city's police force.

The first state chapter - BLEXIT North Carolina -
paid a visit to local officers in July. Our State Director
showered them with thank-you notes and delicious food as a token
of BLEXIT's appreciation.

If you 'Back the Blue' - and believe that we must
support local heroes - please sign the national petition right
away.

While the 'defund the police' crowd wants us to
think minorities stand with them - polls show that the vast
majority of black voters (more than 80%) want police funding to
stay the same or even increase.

We've been sold a lot of lies by anti-police
radicals - those lies have been a detriment to Black American
culture, the country as a whole, and the police officers who
fight for justice every day.

We must stop the deception that is harming urban
communities and demeaning police around the nation.

If you are an American, no matter what color you
are, you should want law and you should want order. That is the
way forward.

Join me in letting our police officers know that
you support law and order, justice, and their valiant efforts to
keep our communities safe.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

Candace Owens

Chair of BLEXIT

I’m fighting for the people of this country who politicians have failed time and time again. People who deserve better. **People like my mom and abuela.** My mother and grandmother came here from Cuba during the freedom flights in the late 1960s. What my family had to go through just to eat and have a roof over their heads is a testament to the resilience and drive of immigrants. But it is also an incredibly sad story. What would it have been like if our country was committed to equity when moving here? If money wasn’t an issue? If she had not been exploited by Miami factories that had her working 70+ hours a week for almost nothing. Where would our people be? **People like my barber.** He was deprived of his right to vote due to a 20 year old felony. He committed a crime of desperation, served his debt to society, and became a successful businessman. Yet he still couldn’t participate in our democracy. I’m so very proud that while working at the ACLU, I organized the movement that restored voting rights to 1.6 million Floridians with previous felonies. But there is so much work to be done. **People like Josh.** A houseless man I met when I was pumping gas during my campaign. One of my campaign buttons rolled out the door when I was getting out of the car. He picked it up and asked “who is Maxwell Alejandro Frost?” I told him it was me and we got to talking about what I hoped to do if I was elected. He couldn’t conceive of the possibility of Medicare for All and healthcare as a human right, because he hadn’t been to the doctor in years. He asked me _“what do I have to do to deserve healthcare?”_ **This system that makes life more difficult for the most vulnerable among us is no accident, Peter. It is by design. And the people who want to keep it that way will spend countless sums of dark money to stop any chance of progress we have.** [I came to Congress so I could fight for my loved ones and yours, but I'll only stay here with the support of grassroots donors like you. clean_body: | ~~ ~~ But first, it is important you understand why I ran to serve one of the most diverse districts in the country, where there’s been a serious lack of investment and most people can’t afford an unexpected $300 expense. I’m fighting for the people of this country who politicians have failed time and time again. People who deserve better. People like my mom and abuela. My mother and grandmother came here from Cuba during the freedom flights in the late 1960s. What my family had to go through just to eat and have a roof over their heads is a testament to the resilience and drive of immigrants. But it is also an incredibly sad story. What would it have been like if our country was committed to equity when moving here? If money wasn’t an issue? If she had not been exploited by Miami factories that had her working 70+ hours a week for almost nothing. Where would our people be? People like my barber. He was deprived of his right to vote due to a 20 year old felony. He committed a crime of desperation, served his debt to society, and became a successful businessman. Yet he still couldn’t participate in our democracy. I’m so very proud that while working at the ACLU, I organized the movement that restored voting rights to 1.6 million Floridians with previous felonies. But there is so much work to be done. People like Josh. A houseless man I met when I was pumping gas during my campaign. One of my campaign buttons rolled out the door when I was getting out of the car. He picked it up and asked “who is Maxwell Alejandro Frost?” I told him it was me and we got to talking about what I hoped to do if I was elected. He couldn’t conceive of the possibility of Medicare for All and healthcare as a human right, because he hadn’t been to the doctor in years. He asked me “what do I have to do to deserve healthcare?” This system that makes life more difficult for the most vulnerable among us is no accident, Peter. It is by design. name: Mae Krier
subject: One of the original Rosies
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
_This is a longer email from Mae Krier, one of the original Rosie the Riveters, about why she supports Senator Bob Casey.**[But before you keep reading, will you join Mae in supporting our campaign by pitching in $5?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240702-2?refcode=em20240702-2&refcode2=3446_552475_c_vfhG&akid=3446%2E552475%2Ec_vfhG)**_
* * *
Hi Peter,
My name is Mae Krier, and I was a “Rosie.”
If you haven’t heard of Rosie the Riveter, she was an icon from World War II who represented women like me who worked in factories producing war supplies.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240702-2?refcode=em20240702-2&refcode2=3446_552475_c_vfhG&akid=3446%2E552475%2Ec_vfhG)
Many years ago, long before I settled down in Pennsylvania, I went to work in a Seattle factory to rivet bombers for our boys overseas. I was just a kid — 17 years old to be exact.
Up until 1941, it was a man’s world. They didn’t realize how capable American women were, but the war changed everything. The Rosies were instrumental in winning the war, and those who fought will tell you the same.
That’s why I spent decades advocating for the service that Rosies like myself provided to be formally honored by the U.S. government — **and Bob Casey answered that call.****He fought to get Rosie the Congressional Gold Medal, which was awarded in April as a tribute to the underrecognized effort of American women to win the war****.**
I love Bob Casey — that’s why I’m emailing you today.
Our Commonwealth is a better place because of Senator Casey. He has spent his entire career fighting for Pennsylvanians like me and fought to ensure that women everywhere finally got the recognition they deserve. I want to do everything in my power to ensure that he is re-elected in 2024.
**[If there’s one thing I know from my time as a Rosie, it’s that many hands make light work. So today, I’m hoping you’ll consider chipping in $5 or $7.50 to Bob Casey’s re-election campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240702-2?refcode=em20240702-2&refcode2=3446_552475_c_vfhG&akid=3446%2E552475%2Ec_vfhG)**
**[Chip in $5 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240702-2?refcode=em20240702-2&refcode2=3446_552475_c_vfhG&akid=3446%2E552475%2Ec_vfhG)**
Thank you for reading this. It means the world to me to advocate for my favorite Senator. Together, we can do it!
Best,
Mae Krier

What. A. Quarter, friend.

My team and I have been hitting your inbox pretty hard over the last few days, working tirelessly to meet our major mid-year fundraising goal. And thanks to your support, we’ve crossed another major hurdle on the path to November.

I'm not just throwing around words when I say we couldn't do this without you. Every donation, no matter the size, allows us to organize across the nation and gets us one step closer to taking back our House majority.

But make no mistake: The MAGA right will try and undercut our movement at any chance they get.

Right now, they’re pointing their money machine at vulnerable districts across the country — and as a ranking Democrat in the House, I need to be able to jump in and help my fellow Democrats if they’re in a fundraising crunch.

Friend, take today to catch your breath and reset for the new month — and new quarter — ahead. Because from now until November 5, the fight to take back our House majority is going to be an arms race, and I’ll need all hands on deck.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for standing beside me in this fight.

Eric

Team,
I hope this email finds you in good health and good spirits. I just wanted to take a moment to give you a quick update on some recent developments.
Throughout the campaign, we warned that outside groups were interfering to buy this election. Now we have irrefutable proof thanks to the recently released June finance reports - and the residents of OR-03 deserve to know - that the America Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) and their GOP megadonors [https://docquery.fec.gov/cgi-bin/forms/C00874875/1791881/] were behind the millions of dollars that poured into this race, including to smear my name and my record. [https://youtu.be/d3ryCuMpOf8?si=JvA1Tj8iATFsaghV]
https://x.com/rpyers/status/1803894219859464465?s=46&t=JzTQmBcwQY_cxMwp9sDzPw [https://x.com/rpyers/status/1803894219859464465?s=46&t=JzTQmBcwQY_cxMwp9sDzPw]
No one should be able to contribute unlimited amounts to elect the candidates of their choice - because this further concentrates power in the hands of the wealthy and powerful. Republicans should not be able to interfere in Democratic primaries - because they are actively opposing our agenda and should not select our representatives. And finally, voters have the right to know who’s flooding the airwaves, and why.
I am so proud of what we accomplished together - the attention we brought to the corrosive role of money in politics. Now we must continue to fight for the changes that will strengthen our democracy, and hold our leaders accountable by making sure they represent us with the values, integrity, and unwavering passion we deserve.
As I mentioned in my concession speech, the campaign may be over, but the work continues. I'll be taking time in the coming weeks to rest, reflect, and plan what comes next. I'm also working to close out the remainder of the campaign –– if you haven't already, please consider donating to help me close out my campaign debt. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sj4c-closeout]
Thank you again, from the bottom of my heart, for your trust and partnership. I look forward to staying in touch.
–– Susheela

name: Pennsylvania Forward Party
subject: Pennsylvania Forward Party July Newsletter
body:
A time to reflect on where we are and what we're doing

|
#
## **Let's do something else**
The recent presidential debate between President Biden and former President Trump has sparked intense national discussion about the state of the upcoming election and the fitness of either of these candidates. This event should serve as an inflection point, highlighting long-standing issues within the two-party system. Are these really our only two choices, and if so, why? The current political landscape is a result of individual office holders and the major parties prioritizing their own power over the best governance or the will of the people. While they may believe their actions serve a greater good, this approach often leads to compromising principles and resisting progress that threatens their control. It is inherently anti-compromise and it has deteriorated now to the point of failure. The parties have effectively created a narrative of binary choice, framing the opposition as an existential threat, and anyone outside the major parties as naive or untruthful to discourage voters from considering alternatives. This particular situation didn't arise overnight but is the result of missed opportunities and systemic inertia. The Republican primary, while initially competitive, ultimately galvanized around Trump, partially in response to the steady stream of news coverage of his on-going legal trouble. On the Democratic side, Biden's team strategically maneuvered to secure his renomination, while challengers like Dean Phillips, Marianne Williamson, and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. were dismissed almost entirely and thus failed to gain significant traction. In a larger sense, these failures are the nearly inevitable result of the system as it is now and can only be understood by asking why we do things the way we do and what stops us from changing. The ongoing dominance of the two-party system reflects a broader failure to build viable alternatives. Organizations like the Forward Party are working to change this status quo. There are no less than 6 well supported presidential candidates in this race. There are election reform and anti polarization advocacy groups in almost every state. The interest in the Libertarian Party, the Green Party, re-emergence of the Reform Party, and the efforts by other minor parties across the country show that there is real demand for this change. Pair that with a decentralized independent media, and we have the potential for a political revolution if only our citizens can get over their divisions to realize it. We can have a system that considers more than 2 options, that allows politicians to represent their constituents without toeing party lines. We can hear long form conversations with all candidates where they lay out detailed arguments instead of 2 minute sound bites. We can have elections where we have trouble choosing between all the great candidates. We can have unconventional candidates running for offices at all levels of government so we get the wisdom of all parts of American life into our government. We can use this debate and its aftermath can serve as an inflection point making it clear that things can not go on the way they are. If your mindset today is disbelief that we are doing this, we humbly suggest that we can do something else.
##

**
** What else can you do, you ask? How about get a couple great candidates from an exciting new party on the ballot? Just a few hours can make all the difference. At the end of this month, we're turning in the signatures we all have gathered. If it's enough, we'll have candidates on the ballot this November and can be a recognized minor party by the end of the year. This is the number one best way you can help right now to establish something new. People desperately want to sign this petition when given the opportunity. Someone just has to ask them. Click this link to see the form and the instructions. clean_body: A time to reflect on where we are and what we're doing | Let's do something else The recent presidential debate between President Biden and former President Trump has sparked intense national discussion about the state of the upcoming election and the fitness of either of these candidates. This event should serve as an inflection point, highlighting long-standing issues within the two-party system. Are these really our only two choices, and if so, why? The current political landscape is a result of individual office holders and the major parties prioritizing their own power over the best governance or the will of the people. While they may believe their actions serve a greater good, this approach often leads to compromising principles and resisting progress that threatens their control. It is inherently anti-compromise and it has deteriorated now to the point of failure. The parties have effectively created a narrative of binary choice, framing the opposition as an existential threat, and anyone outside the major parties as naive or untruthful to discourage voters from considering alternatives. This particular situation didn't arise overnight but is the result of missed opportunities and systemic inertia. The Republican primary, while initially competitive, ultimately galvanized around Trump, partially in response to the steady stream of news coverage of his on-going legal trouble. On the Democratic side, Biden's team strategically maneuvered to secure his renomination, while challengers like Dean Phillips, Marianne Williamson, and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. were dismissed almost entirely and thus failed to gain significant traction. In a larger sense, these failures are the nearly inevitable result of the system as it is now and can only be understood by asking why we do things the way we do and what stops us from changing. The ongoing dominance of the two-party system reflects a broader failure to build viable alternatives. Organizations like the Forward Party are working to change this status quo. There are no less than 6 well supported presidential candidates in this race. There are election reform and anti polarization advocacy groups in almost every state. The interest in the Libertarian Party, the Green Party, re-emergence of the Reform Party, and the efforts by other minor parties across the country show that there is real demand for this change. Pair that with a decentralized independent media, and we have the potential for a political revolution if only our citizens can get over their divisions to realize it. We can have a system that considers more than 2 options, that allows politicians to represent their constituents without toeing party lines. We can hear long form conversations with all candidates where they lay out detailed arguments instead of 2 minute sound bites. We can have elections where we have trouble choosing between all the great candidates. We can have unconventional candidates running for offices at all levels of government so we get the wisdom of all parts of American life into our government. We can use this debate and its aftermath can serve as an inflection point making it clear that things can not go on the way they are. If your mindset today is disbelief that we are doing this, we humbly suggest that we can do something else. Opportunity to help ends this month: Collect Signatures for our candidates What else can you do, you ask? How about get a couple great candidates from an exciting new party on the ballot? Just a few hours can make all the difference. At the end of this month, we're turning in the signatures we all have gathered. If it's enough, we'll have candidates on the ballot this November and can be a recognized minor party by the end of the year. This is the number one best way you can help right now to establish something new. People desperately want to sign this petition when given the opportunity. Someone just has to ask them. body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88126837/483206241/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjA1YWRjZC1hOTM4LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TLmorNAo2OEu9B-rywn5wx7iiX-hSCQTppgyC67MzlQ=) I owe you such a huge thank you. Thanks to this incredible grassroots team, we blasted through our grassroots fundraising goal before Sunday’s FEC deadline. We’re still tallying the numbers, but it’s clearly a result that every single person who has played a role in this campaign should be proud of. You don’t need me to tell you how important this election is. It’s uncertain, it’s stressful, and it seems like every day, something happens that raises the stakes even higher. But here’s something that’s within our control: we’re going to work as hard as we can, every single day between now and November, to get our message out there in this must-win district. We’re going to fight back against the false attacks we face, and we’re going to use every tool and every advantage we have to make sure every single voter knows my record and what I stand for when they cast their ballot this fall. If we do that, we’ve got the very best shot at flipping the House, reinstating abortion rights, and defending our democracy. **And do you want to know one of our biggest advantages in this fight? | SWVA is **NOT** a dump site for the rest of the state or the country.
* **Moss III** in Russell County would have been the second largest PRIVATE landfill in the US. That's right! Not for SWVA... for outside trash... right on the Clinch River.

* The **MOUNTAIN VALLEY PIPELINE** will carry oil for export across our farmlands, rivers, and streams. That's right... not for domestic use.

* **Holston Army Ammunition Plant (HSAAP)** in Radford manufactures Research Department Explosive (RDX) and High Melting Explosive (HMX) for ammunition production and development. In June 2015, the plant requested a renewal of its permit of an open burning ground which it has used for decades to dispose of its waste. The ground is "located on the north bank of the New River in the Horseshoe Area, a section of the plant surrounded on three sides by the river". clean_body: | | | | | | SWVA is NOT a dump site for the rest of the state or the country. Moss III in Russell County would have been the second largest PRIVATE landfill in the US. That's right! Not for SWVA... for outside trash... right on the Clinch River. The MOUNTAIN VALLEY PIPELINE will carry oil for export across our farmlands, rivers, and streams. That's right... not for domestic use. Holston Army Ammunition Plant (HSAAP) in Radford manufactures Research Department Explosive (RDX) and High Melting Explosive (HMX) for ammunition production and development. In June 2015, the plant requested a renewal of its permit of an open burning ground which it has used for decades to dispose of its waste. The ground is "located on the north bank of the New River in the Horseshoe Area, a section of the plant surrounded on three sides by the river". When I am in Washington I will fight for real jobs and real investments that don't put our people and natural resources at risk. Your donation to my campaign will help make that a reality. I won't let SWVA become anybody's dumping Ground! | | Yesterday, the Supreme Court placed our democracy in grave danger. By a 6-3 vote along ideological lines, the conservative majority ruled that the President can not be criminally prosecuted for any "official acts". What is an official act? Well, according to Trump's lawyers during oral arguments, an official act could include **the President ordering a military coup or the assassination of a political rival.** _As of yesterday, SCOTUS effectively agreed with the Trump team's chilling assertion that the President would be immune from prosecution if he were to order the killing of a political rival._ Let me say that again - Trump's own lawyers said that Trump could order a political opponent jailed or murdered and he could not be held accountable - and the MAGA Supreme Court agreed. Donald Trump has welcomed authoritarianism with open arms, and since leaving office, he's given statements in which he promises**"a bloodbath"** if he loses the election and to be **"a dictator on day one"** if he wins. As Trump's grip on the GOP has intensified, so has the anti-democratic agenda within the party. What this tells us is that no matter if Trump wins or loses in November, we've got a lot of work to do in order to reverse the damage done to our republic by the MAGA movement and their allies in the courts. We will be tested harder than ever before in the weeks, months, and years to come — but I promise I will never stop believing in our democracy and fighting for the principle that _the people_ matter more than the whims of a wannabe dictator. Joe Biden with the help of a Democratic Congress has made big progress leveling the playing field for working families and will be able to deliver even more for the American people if re-elected. On the other end of the spectrum, Donald Trump and his advisors – and I quote – "plan to immediately test the boundaries of presidential and governing power, knowing the restraints of Congress and the courts are dramatically looser than during his first term." Trump's first term as president was disastrous, but imagine how much worse a second term will be now that the Supreme Court has essentially given him the power to get away with just about anything. This phrase gets thrown around a lot, but I can't overstate just how dire the consequences of November's election will be for the future of our country. There are two clear choices on the ballot this year, and now more than ever before, our grassroots movement needs to step up and push back against Trump's radical agenda. clean_body: | | | | Yesterday, the Supreme Court placed our democracy in grave danger. By a 6-3 vote along ideological lines, the conservative majority ruled that the President can not be criminally prosecuted for any "official acts". What is an official act? Well, according to Trump's lawyers during oral arguments, an official act could include the President ordering a military coup or the assassination of a political rival. As of yesterday, SCOTUS effectively agreed with the Trump team's chilling assertion that the President would be immune from prosecution if he were to order the killing of a political rival. Let me say that again - Trump's own lawyers said that Trump could order a political opponent jailed or murdered and he could not be held accountable - and the MAGA Supreme Court agreed. Donald Trump has welcomed authoritarianism with open arms, and since leaving office, he's given statements in which he promises"a bloodbath" if he loses the election and to be "a dictator on day one" if he wins. As Trump's grip on the GOP has intensified, so has the anti-democratic agenda within the party. What this tells us is that no matter if Trump wins or loses in November, we've got a lot of work to do in order to reverse the damage done to our republic by the MAGA movement and their allies in the courts. We will be tested harder than ever before in the weeks, months, and years to come — but I promise I will never stop believing in our democracy and fighting for the principle that the people matter more than the whims of a wannabe dictator. Joe Biden with the help of a Democratic Congress has made big progress leveling the playing field for working families and will be able to deliver even more for the American people if re-elected. On the other end of the spectrum, Donald Trump and his advisors – and I quote – "plan to immediately test the boundaries of presidential and governing power, knowing the restraints of Congress and the courts are dramatically looser than during his first term." Trump's first term as president was disastrous, but imagine how much worse a second term will be now that the Supreme Court has essentially given him the power to get away with just about anything. This phrase gets thrown around a lot, but I can't overstate just how dire the consequences of November's election will be for the future of our country. There are two clear choices on the ballot this year, and now more than ever before, our grassroots movement needs to step up and push back against Trump's radical agenda. I'm all in, and I hope you'll join me.
